[[EuroLeague]] | team = FC Barcelona Lassa | birth_date = {{Birth date and age|2000|9|11|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Córdoba Province, Argentina|Las Varillas, Argentina]] | nationality = Argentine | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | draft_league = | career_start = 2017 | years1 = 2017–2018 | team1 = [[Estudiantes de Bahía Blanca]] | years2 = 2018–present | team2 = [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] | years3 = 2018–present | team3 = →[[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]] | highlights = *[[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2018) | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|ARG}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA South America Under-17 Championship for Men|FIBA U-17 South American Championship]]}} {{MedalSilver|2017 Peru|[[Argentina national under-17 basketball team|Under-17]]}} }} '''Leandro Nicolás Bolmaro''' (born 11 September 2000) is an Argentine-Italian[https://www.acb.com/jugador/temporada-a-temporada/id/20213026 LEANDRO BOLMARO Nacionalidad: Italia {{in lang|es}}.][https://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=008985 BOLMARO, LEANDRO NATIONALITY: ITALY.] professional [[basketball]] player for [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona Lassa]] of the [[Liga ACB]]. He is considered one of the best international prospects in the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=NBA mock draft: What would the likely lottery teams do at No. 1? |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/insider/story/_/id/28453206/nba-mock-draft-likely-lottery-teams-do-no-1 |website=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=11 January 2020 |date=10 January 2020}} ==Early years and youth career== Bolmaro began playing the sport of basketball in his home country of [[Argentina]]. He started playing with the youth teams of a local [[sports club|club]] named Almafuerte de Las Varillas, in [[Córdoba Province, Argentina|Córdoba]]. On 13 April 2018, he played for the World Team at the [[Nike Hoop Summit]] in [[Portland, Oregon]].{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=World Team roster announced for Nike Hoop Summit |url=https://www.espn.com/blog/nba/post/_/id/32598/world-team-roster-announced-for-nike-hoop-summit |website=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=11 January 2020 |date=6 April 2018}} ==Professional career== ===Argentina=== Bolmaro began his pro career on 16 July 2017, when he was 16 years old, after he signed with [[Estudiantes de Bahía Blanca]] of the [[Liga Nacional de Básquet]], the top basketball league in Argentina.{{cite web |title=Bahía sumó dos chicos de enorme proyección: Lugarini y Bolmaro |url=https://basquetplus.com/articulo/bahía-sumó-dos-chicos-de-enorme-proyección-lugarini-y-bolmaro |website=Básquet Plus |accessdate=11 January 2020 |language=Spanish |date=16 July 2017}} In 23 games played during the [[2017–18 Liga Nacional de Básquet season|2017–18 season]], Bolmaro averaged 2.0 points, 0.7 rebounds, 0.5 assists, and 0.4 steals, in 7.2 minutes per game. He shot 37.3% overall from the field, 53.6% on 2-point field goals, 17.4% on 3-point field goals, and 75.0% on free throws.[https://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=008985#!careerstats BOLMARO, LEANDRO Career Stats Other Competition.]{{cite web |last1=Castrejón |first1=Andrés |title=En Barcelona presumen de Leandro Bolmaro, su "Messi" del básquetbol |url=http://ar.marca.com/claro/basquetbol/2019/10/14/5da4e5dcca47414e488b4593.html |website=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]] |accessdate=11 January 2020 |language=Spanish |date=14 October 2019}} ===Spain=== For the [[2018–19 LEB Oro season|2018–19 season]], Bolmaro moved to Spanish club [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]]. He averaged 10.4 points, 3.1 rebounds, 2.7 assists, and 1.2 steals per game for club's the [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|reserve team]], while playing in the [[Liga Española de Baloncesto|LEB Oro]], Spain's second-tier level league. With the reserve team, he played in a total of 33 games, and averaged 24.1 minutes per game of playing time. He shot 39.6% overall from the field, 45.5% on 2-point field goals, 30.8% on 3-point field goals, and 65.2% on free throws.[http://competiciones.feb.es/estadisticas/Jugador.aspx?i=792134&c=2325541&med=0 BOLMARO, LEANDRO NICOLAS Temporada: 18/19 Equipo: BARÇA LASSA {{in lang|es}}.] In [[2019–20 FC Barcelona Bàsquet season|Barcelona's 2019–20 season]], he split playing time between Barcelona's reserve team and senior team, which competed in the [[Liga ACB]], the highest level Spanish league, and the [[EuroLeague]].{{cite web |last1=Codocea |first1=Mauricio |title=La historia de Leandro Bolmaro, el otro argentino al que le dicen “Messi” en Barcelona |url=https://www.clarin.com/deportes/leandro-bolmaro-proceso_0_ZxdLRVr5.html |website=[[Clarín (Argentine newspaper)|Clarín]] |accessdate=11 January 2020 |language=Spanish |date=17 October 2019}} During the [[2019–20 LEB Plata season|2019–20 Spanish 3rd Division]] season, while playing with Barcelona's reserve B team, he averaged 14.9 points, 2.7 rebounds, 3.6 assists, and 1.8 steals, in 26.3 minutes per game, in 9 games played in the [[LEB Plata|Spanish 3rd Division]]. On 13 August 2020, Bolmaro signed a contract extension with Barcelona through 2023.{{cite web |title=Barcelona signs Leandro Bolmaro to multi-year contract extension |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/barcelona-signs-leandro-bolmaro-to-multi-year-contract-extension/ |website=Sportando |accessdate=13 August 2020 |date=13 August 2020}} ==National team career== In 2017, Bolmaro won a silver medal with [[Argentina national under-17 basketball team|Argentina's Under-17 national team]] at the [[FIBA South America Under-17 Championship for Men|FIBA South America Under-17 Championship]] in [[Lima]], Peru. He averaged a team-high 13.8 points per game.{{cite web |title=Chile and Argentina will play for South American U17 Gold |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/sudamericano/u17/2017/news/chile-and-argentina-will-play-for-south-american-u17-gold |website=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=11 January 2020 |date=21 July 2017}} Bolmaro also represented the [[Argentina men's national under-19 basketball team|Argentine Under-19 national team]] at the [[2019 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup|2019 FIBA Under-19 World Cup]] in [[Heraklion]], Greece, where his team finished in 11th place. He left the tournament's opening game early, with a minor strain.{{cite web |title=Barcelona’s Bolmaro injured in FIBA U19 World Cup first day |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba/900680/barcelonas-bolmaro-injured-in-fiba-u19-world-cup-first-day/ |website=EuroHoops |accessdate=11 January 2020 |date=30 June 2019}} During the tournament, he was Argentina's leading scorer, with an average of 10.8 points per game. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.leandrobolmaro.com/ Leandro Bolmaro website] *[http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/rpp//q/leandro%20bolmaro/pid//_//players.html FIBA Profile] *[https://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=008985#!careerstats Euroleague.net Profile] *[https://www.acb.com/jugador/temporada-a-temporada/id/20213026 Liga ACB Profile] {{in lang|es}} *[http://competiciones.feb.es/estadisticas/Jugador.aspx?i=792134&c=2325541&med=0 Spanish 2nd Division / 3rd Division Profile] {{in lang|es}} {{FC Barcelona Bàsquet current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bolmaro, Leandro}} [[Category:2000 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Argentine expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:Argentine men's basketball players]] [[Category:Estudiantes de Bahía Blanca basketball players]] [[Category:FC Barcelona Bàsquet players]] [[Category:FC Barcelona Bàsquet B players]] [[Category:Italian expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:Italian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Liga ACB players]] [[Category:People from Córdoba Province, Argentina]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]]
